query: {i:original input receiver index,r:rotor0..3,terminals:[terminal]}; input receiver then rotor order
scan: {kind:scan,entries:[{j:original input source index,result}],zeroCount}; exactly one terminal per complete/fallback query; all missing nonself sources explicitly claim zero
leaf: {kind:leaf,node:preorder ID,entries:[{j:original input source index,result}],zeroCount}; all missing nonself members explicitly claim zero; entries input-source sorted
zero: {kind:zero,node:preorder ID,rule:declared first valid proof,count:exact nonself member count}; empty self-only coverage allowed and counted as actual traversal
positiveResult: {status:positive,branch:active,coefficient:{l,u}}; all positive exact-domain/cap conditions independently checked; coefficient contains fixed192 independent reference
refusedResult: {status:rejected|unresolved,branch}; no permitted unresolved or stress exception in this suite
globalGuard: null or {passed:boolean,checks:{centerComponent:boolean,centerNorm:boolean,rotorComponent:boolean,down:boolean,radial:boolean}}; all checks evaluated independently; completed false proof alone chooses fallback
tree: {permutation:[stableID],nodes:[{id,start,end,left,right,center,axis}]}; center/axis each3 arrays [lowerRational,upperRational]; exact extrema; preorder; leaf incoming order retained; root<=8 preserves input order
indexPolicy: Query i and entry j are original input indices. Prepared/solve/load IDs, tree permutation and canonical result witness i/j are stable IDs. Canonical outcome order is input receiver/rotor/input-source, never traversal order.
preparation: All drones prepared independently per method before self exclusion; raw invalid=>null, preparation invalid=>prepared object; global invalid=>noqueries, guard/tree/solve/certificate null, only preparationCalls=N
commonResult: {status:certified|tolerance-failed|rejected|unresolved|resource,branch,witness:null|{id}|{i,r,j},toleranceAchieved:null|boolean}; inherited canonical priority; no source/reference expectedClass oracle
solve: null or {iterations:48,bisections:54,candidate:[{id:stableID,x:4lowercase16hex}]}; candidate untrusted finite0<x<=1; no independent native proposal replay
certificateChecks: Full returned coefficient boxes and exact candidate-derived source enclosure cover complete s; p encloses xhat^3+xhat*returned s; kbar>=max(1,pU,1/pL), pL>0, Kbar>=all kbar; roots contain exact corollary and independent fixed192/fixed128 reference; exact candidate loads; signed load boxes cover entire returned root box and independent reference; all3 full-box Euclidean norm error proofs; exact mg/4,mg,mg*R; upper*100000000<=2^96
interval: {l,u} canonical signed integer strings /2^96; ordered endpoints in[-2^352,2^352]; <=108characters each
rational: {n,d} canonical integer strings,d>0,gcd=1; load integers<=4096characters; tree numerator<=310,denominator<=324characters
controlWitnessOrder: First scene in spec order, hierarchy method, receiver input index then rotor then deterministic terminal order then entry input-source order; admitted root/error witnesses use input drone then rotor. Controls independently require referenced proof witnesses and run same core without journal. Missing witness fails coverage.

controlRecipes.missing-source-subtree: Remove first hierarchy terminal with nonempty nonself members; record uncovered member.
controlRecipes.duplicate-source-coverage: Duplicate same terminal; record overlapping member.
controlRecipes.false-zero-active-leaf: Replace first hierarchy leaf containing an oracle-positive member with zero terminal rule neighbor, preserving complete leaf membership; witness positive member disproves zero.
controlRecipes.omitted-positive-entry: Remove first positive hierarchy leaf entry and increment zeroCount, preserving count arithmetic; oracle proves implicit zero false.
controlRecipes.wrong-tree-membership: Swap first2 distinct stable IDs in first tree permutation of size>=2; retain nodes; independent deterministic permutation must disagree.
controlRecipes.wrong-tree-bound: In first reconstructed tree node/coordinate with lower<upper, replace saved lower endpoint with exact upper; witness excluded lower extremum.
controlRecipes.altered-prepared-offset: Flip1least-significant bit of first admitted method prepared offset; raw input remains unchanged. No undeclared stale-state cross-scene claim.
controlRecipes.false-global-guard: In first failed hierarchy guard, replace failed booleans and passed with true while retaining saved fallback; proof/mode inconsistency independently rejected.
controlRecipes.incomplete-fallback: Remove first nonzero fallback entry and increment zeroCount; independent nonzero witness required.
controlRecipes.altered-positive-coefficient: Set first hierarchy positive coefficient with independent lower>0 to[0,0].
controlRecipes.false-root-one: Set first admitted affected root to[1,1], requiring independent upper<1.
controlRecipes.altered-candidate: Flip one least-significant candidate bit at first affected admitted root without updating exact loads.
controlRecipes.false-error-zero: Set first rotor error to0 where exact candidate lies strictly outside independent root interval; save positive exact normalized gap.
controlRecipes.duplicate-scene: Replace second scene by deep copy of first.

controlValidation: Each mutation must fail its independently targeted core error family; method equality is checked only after both semantic method validators pass. Equality-only rejection is never an effective control.
